source_title: IND vs NZ 3rd T20I: Abhishek Sharma Smashes 15-Ball Fifty As Indian Openers Race Towards 199
source_excerpt:
IND vs NZ 3rd T20I: India got off to a blistering start in their chase of 199 against New Zealand in the third T20I, with Abhishek Sharma bringing up his half-century in just 15 deliveries. The left-handed opener reached the milestone as India raced to 80 without loss in 3.4 overs, putting the hosts under immediate pressure.
Abhishek was unbeaten on 55 when India reached 80/0, while teenage opener Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was providing support with an aggressive 19 off eight balls. The opening pair's explosive start gave India early momentum in pursuit of New Zealand's total of 198/3.
Abhishek's rapid half-century set the tone for India's chase, as he reached 50 in only 15 balls. His attacking approach put New Zealand's bowlers under pressure in the opening overs and helped India maintain a scoring rate well above the required rate.
With Abhishek already on 55, India had scored 80 runs without losing a wicket inside four overs. The left-hander's early assault gave India a strong platform, although the chase still had a long way to go.
